abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Verify Product Details Page Displays Complete Product Information
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case: 1

Test Case Title: Verify Product Details Page Displays Complete Product Information

Module: Product Details

Priority: High

Preconditions:
- User is logged into the application.
- At least one product is available and visible in a collection or category.

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to any product collection or category page.
2. Click on a visible product to open its Product Details page.
3. Verify that the Product Details page is displayed.
4. Check that the product price is visible on the Product Details page.
5. Check that the product description is present.
6. Check that information about materials used is displayed.
7. Check that available sizes for the product are listed.
8. Locate and click the option to view the size guide for rings.
9. Verify that the ring size guide opens or is displayed.

Expected Result:
- Product Details page opens when a product is clicked.
- Product price, description, materials used, and available sizes are all clearly displayed.
- Option to view a size guide for rings is present.
- Ring size guide opens or appears successfully when the option is selected.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Update Personal Information from My Account Page
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case: 1

Test Case Title: Update Personal Information from My Account Page  
Module: Account Settings  
Priority: High  

Preconditions:  
- User is registered and logged in.

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the home page after logging in.
2. Click the "Account" link located on the navigation bar.
3. On the My Account page, locate the fields for name, email, and password.
4. Update the name field with a new valid name.
5. Update the email field with a new valid email address.
6. Update the password field with a new valid password.
7. Click the Save or Update button.
8. Observe the confirmation or success message, if any.
9. Verify that the updated name, email, and password are immediately reflected on the My Account page.

Expected Result:
- User is navigated to the My Account page upon clicking the "Account" link.
- Account settings fields for name, email, and password are displayed.
- Changes to name, email, and password are saved successfully.
- Updated information is displayed immediately on the My Account page.
- A success or confirmation message is shown, if applicable.
